agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review mutates no formal state/code and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.

v2.1 direct classification keeps DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND operational-only; they must never become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.
Strict bool validation in v2/v2.1 is valid type hardening but is not source provenance, freshness proof, verifier authority or acceptance proof.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only and does not independently raise gear; keeping it observational is acceptable until independently derived and adversarially validated.
The v2.1 contract correctly leaves speedup NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.

disagreements.finding: New material objection: v2 obtains canonical N/R from the verified v1 selector, but then its recovery/anchor/RED-secretary branch unconditionally replaces selected with G1. Therefore standby=True plus recovery_active/anchor<0.50/fresh RED, or rollback_required=True plus those signals, can erase the terminal N/R control state before v2.1 sees it. The later v2.1 N/R parsing bypass cannot protect a terminal state already overwritten inside v2.
disagreements.required_change: Define terminal precedence explicitly. Trusted rollback R must be non-overridable by secretary/pressure/recovery overlays; standby N may only be superseded by a separately specified higher-priority trusted safety/authority rule, never by an unbound secretary signal. Return terminal decisions before nonterminal pressure overlays or consume a trusted terminal-authority envelope.

disagreements.finding: GearboxV21Decision omits inherited v2 checkpoint_required, receiver_ack_required, verification_gate, real_experience_claim_allowed and pressure_score semantics.
disagreements.required_change: Re-project all safety-critical inherited v2 metadata or bind an exact inherited-v2 decision fingerprint/reference; v2.1 may tighten but never erase inherited safety constraints.

disagreements.finding: v2 gates real_experience_claim_allowed on C_VERIFIED, while v2.1 independently recomputes verified_experience_delta from caller event fields without consuming the inherited verification-stage eligibility result.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero authoritative verified delta must originate from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt binding exact evidence identity, trusted C/independent-verifier receipt and canonical verification stage.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal True can label stale telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and runtime/install identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope with trusted source and freshness metadata.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=True only replaces secretary_level with UNKNOWN; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision, so permissive caller kwargs still determine routing.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: Secretary freshness gates secretary_level only. Numeric pressure components have no per-field provenance/freshness, so stale secretary-derived telemetry can still force checkpoint/downshift.
disagreements.required_change: Bind source/freshness per pressure component; stale secretary-derived values contribute zero while independently trusted fresh runtime telemetry may contribute.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is currently reason-only, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if later connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from a precommitted denominator/window and tested against self-reinforcement.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation. Same evidence under new IDs and exact IDs across later calls/restart/rollback/poll can be re-credited; same-ID/different-binding is not durably detected.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay NO_OP, same-evidence/new-ID lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events forms event identity with str(event_id).strip(), allowing arbitrary caller types, numeric/string aliasing and unstable structured identities.
disagreements.required_change: Define a strict versioned EventIdentity boundary and bind accepted identity to canonical event/evidence/verifier acceptance state.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind plus booleans/stage labels; exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt are not mandatory in the executable path.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields instead of consuming an accepted ledger receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero verified or operational credit must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta although v2.1 defines them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify authoritative v2/v2.1 classification into verified_experience_delta versus operational_progress_delta; operational events must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Terminal N/R overwrite creates mixed-treatment safety behavior: identical rollback/standby intent can produce different control states depending on secretary/recovery/anchor telemetry, invalidating safety and performance comparisons.
Dropping inherited v2 safety metadata can silently remove checkpoint/ACK/verification constraints from downstream v2.1 behavior.
Caller-declared secretary freshness/authority and unbound pressure provenance invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if policy-created progress is later fed back into routing authority.
Transient/noncanonical event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and direct credit bypass can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Cross-layer v2/v2.1 Experience semantics can count the same event differently and contaminate model-selection analysis.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-ROLLBACK-TERMINAL-PRECEDENCE-110: rollback_required=true combined separately with fresh RED secretary, recovery_active=true and continuity_anchor_health<0.50 must preserve R; no nonterminal overlay may convert trusted rollback to G1.
GB21-STANDBY-PRECEDENCE-111: standby=true plus RED/recovery/anchor-failure must follow an explicit preregistered precedence rule; an unbound secretary signal alone may not silently convert N to G1.
GB21-TERMINAL-CROSS-LAYER-112: v1/v2/v2.1 must agree on the exact terminal-control result and preserve it through wrapper projection.
GB21-INHERITED-SAFETY-METADATA-107 + SAFETY-FINGERPRINT-108: v2.1 preserves exact inherited checkpoint/ACK/verification constraints.
GB21-V21-STAGE-BYPASS-105 + STAGE-CONSISTENCY-106: non-C_VERIFIED or receipt-less verified events produce zero authoritative v2.1 verified credit.
GB21-SECRETARY-FRESHNESS-FORGE-109: stale signal plus caller fresh=true is rejected by trusted freshness metadata.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery projects G1 despite permissive fallback kwargs.
GB21-STALE-PRESSURE-PROVENANCE-059 + MIXED-SOURCE-060: stale secretary-derived pressure fields are ignored while trusted independent telemetry remains usable.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift history, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing, Experience, promotion or authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-TYPE-098 + EVENT-ID-ALIAS-099 + EVENT-ID-STRUCTURAL-100: adoptable event identity rejects arbitrary types and uses deterministic canonical semantics.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen metric provenance, crossover/order control, complete assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.

requirements: Preserve verified Gearbox v1 and Step001-009 baselines; candidate failures roll back only v2/v2.1 delta.
Resolve terminal N/R precedence so trusted rollback cannot be overwritten by secretary/pressure/recovery overlays, and standby precedence is explicitly bounded.
Preserve or cryptographically bind inherited v2 checkpoint/ACK/verification safety metadata through v2.1.
Replace caller-declared secretary freshness/authority with trusted replay-resistant envelopes and bind provenance/freshness for each pressure component.
Derive anti-thrash inputs from canonical shift history with precommitted sample/window/uncertainty/hysteretic release and demonstrate cycle/closure/recovery non-regression.
Keep verified_progress_density observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
Implement strict canonical EventIdentity plus durable rollback-resistant event/evidence lineage registry and accepted-receipt projection.
Require exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt and compatible canonical verification stage for every nonzero authoritative verified Experience delta.
Keep DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND operational-only across every authoritative public interface.
Treat 5/4/3/1 weights as heuristic analytics only; never as capability, Trust, Identity, Personality or promotion truth.

Establish speedup only with sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover baseline over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency, with frozen metric provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Obtain fresh exact-current executable evidence plus independent Spirit review and current Navigator synthesis before any A->B->C adoption route.

return_to_runtime: After durable latest-only write/readback, return to Always-on Runtime / Small-World; do not write a QUANTUM dialogue turn unless the authenticated endpoint names QUANTUM next.
